paper.title_en: One-point functions in 2D and 4D SUSY Janus
paper.abstract_en: We calculate one-point functions of the marginal operators dual to the space-varying dilaton in 4D and 2D holographic Janus interfaces, extending the results of \cite{Clark_2005}. We compare the strongly coupled supergravity and weakly coupled CFT limits for $\mathcal{N}=0,1,2,4$ Janus interfaces in 4D $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM and for non-supersymmetric and half-BPS Janus interfaces in the 2D D1--D5 CFT. In 4D, the $\mathcal{N}=0,1$ results agree only to first order in the jump parameter, and the $\mathcal{N}=2,4$ result agrees exactly. In 2D, exact agreement holds for the half-BPS interface, whereas the non-supersymmetric interface agrees only to first order.
